verdict.rationale: A government corporate registry could plausibly publish an API spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only a web Online Filing Centre and PDF forms, and the probe notes the registry documents no transactional API on any surface checked. The open.canada.ca CKAN JSON API is a separate national open-data platform, not the product's own documented machine channel, so it earns no credit here.
